scripts.lint: biome check scripts *.json && pnpm -r --parallel run lint
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write scripts *.json && pnpm -r --parallel run lint:fix
scripts.format: biome format scripts *.json && pnpm -r --parallel run format
scripts.format:fix: biome format --write scripts *.json && pnpm -r --parallel run format:fix
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec -- rm -rf node_modules dist && rimraf node_modules
